description: Create a secure payment link on siima.online for a Siima eSIM plan (Stripe-powered, but hosted on our own site — never a redirect to checkout.stripe.com). Give the returned url to the user to complete payment. Optionally pass the buyer's email to pre-fill the checkout form. The buyer confirms it with a 6-digit code we email them, then pays — nothing is ordered until they do. After payment the buyer is emailed a link to their eSIM within a minute; opening it on their phone gives a one-tap install, the QR code and manual installation codes. No account or signup is required.

currency.description: Currency for prices: "usd", "eur", or "gbp". Defaults to "usd".

email.description: Buyer email to pre-fill at checkout (they verify it before paying; the eSIM is delivered there)

name: create_checkout_link
title: Create eSIM checkout link
